blob_count.description: The number of blobs written to the repository during the test.

blob_path.description: The path in the repository under which all the blobs were written during the test.

concurrency.description: The number of write operations performed concurrently during the test.

coordinating_node.description: The node that coordinated the analysis and performed the final cleanup.

delete_elapsed.description: The time it took to delete all the blobs in the container.

delete_elapsed_nanos.description: The time it took to delete all the blobs in the container, in nanoseconds.

details.description: A description of every read and write operation performed during the test.

early_read_node_count.description: The limit on the number of nodes on which early read operations were performed after writing each blob.

issues_detected.description:
A list of correctness issues detected, which is empty if the API succeeded.
It is included to emphasize that a successful response does not guarantee correct behaviour in future.

listing_elapsed.description: The time it took to retrieve a list of all the blobs in the container.

listing_elapsed_nanos.description: The time it took to retrieve a list of all the blobs in the container, in nanoseconds.

max_blob_size.description: The limit on the size of a blob written during the test.

max_blob_size_bytes.description: The limit, in bytes, on the size of a blob written during the test.

max_total_data_size.description: The limit on the total size of all blob written during the test.

max_total_data_size_bytes.description: The limit, in bytes, on the total size of all blob written during the test.

rare_action_probability.description: The probability of performing rare actions during the test.

read_node_count.description: The limit on the number of nodes on which read operations were performed after writing each blob.

repository.description: The name of the repository that was the subject of the analysis.

seed.description: The seed for the pseudo-random number generator used to generate the operations used during the test.

summary.description: A collection of statistics that summarize the results of the test.
